supporting_pages.title: "An Overview of the Admin API \_|\_ App Engine Admin API \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: The Admin API provides programmatic access to several of the App Engine administrative operations that are found in the Google Cloud console .
The App Engine Admin API is a RESTful API for managing your App Engine applications regardless of programming language.
With the Admin API, you can manage your App Engine applications in manners that best suit your environment or process.
